plot_classification_probability: plot classification probabilities for multiple classifiers on a 2D feature space using DecisionBoundaryDisplay
build_decision_boundary_plot: build a decision boundary plot showing predicted class probabilities with contour levels and scatter markers for test data
evaluate_classifier_metrics: evaluate classifiers using accuracy_score, roc_auc_score, and log_loss on test predictions
create_ml_pipeline: create a scikit-learn pipeline combining feature transformers like Nystroem, KBinsDiscretizer, or SplineTransformer with LogisticRegression
plot_multiclass_probabilities: plot per-class and max-class probability surfaces for all classes in a multiclass classification problem
